_comment: Code anchors org/majkinetor.org depends on. Read by scripts/check-majkinetor-anchors.py. root 'clone' = debug/majkinetor/ (majkinetor's repo), 'saed' = this project. 'regex' is a Python regex matched per line. 'expect': 'present' (default) or 'absent'. 'claim' names the analysis statement that falls if the anchor goes; 'todo' names the org/majkinetor.org TODO item it belongs to (a SAED-side defect anchor disappears when that TODO is fixed). 'line' is the line it was found at the last refresh (drift report only); 'count' (default 1) is how many lines must match.
